brief.symptoms: Consumer group member metadata decoding fails with 'invalid length' when a V3 member includes empty owned partitions.
brief.evidence: consumer_group_members_test.go:93: Failed to decode V3 data kafka: error decoding packet: invalid length
hints: The test reports a decoding error when the broker sends a V3 member record with no partitions assigned.
The failure occurs while reading the owned partitions field of the member metadata.
The code path that handles owned partitions does not correctly support the case where the array length is zero.
brief.lesson: When decoding a V3 member metadata, the decoder must treat an empty owned-partitions array as a valid case and skip the subsequent fields that are version-specific.
